note: What each named planning job must show before a proven job record is accepted. Places are rules (kind and state), never a named place: the record names the places a run actually used. Rules every job shares live in openplan/scripts/ops/capability-evidence.mjs; what a job needs because of what it is lives in its entry here.
ruleNote: journeyFields (every journey) and a journey's fields (that journey only) name a dotted journey field and what it must hold: equals a value, atLeast a number, or minItems entries in a list. The refusal is given with {found} and {expected} filled in. sourceCheck names the subject of an independent count check, the limit to state when it did not match, and what a matched check must name (an https address on one of the listed hosts and a note of at least minNoteLength characters). itemHeadings names, per PDF, the heading each text item must name: the item's text must be that heading, and the heading must be a line of its own on the recorded page. mapPageText names, per PDF, words the export prints on the page with its map; the map item's page must carry them. crossWorkspace.perJourney is count (each required request is checked as many times as the record has journeys) or role (each check names the journey that made it, and each journey has each required request once).

crossWorkspace.note: Lead decision 2026-11-14 (KI-2026-11-14-060). A data check (an API route or a file download) counts only with 403 or 404. A page check also counts with 200 when the journey read the rendered page and found the not-found screen and none of the first account's identifying strings. Each target needs its download refused as a data check; a page check alone never satisfies the rule.

matched.note: Hosts of the crash sources this job reads: NHTSA's FARS annual files and its crash query service, and California's CCRS on the state open data portal (openplan/src/lib/safety/sources/fars.ts, ccrs.ts). The checker cannot repeat the comparison; it checks only that a matched check names an address it could be repeated from and says what was compared.

geoidPatterns.source: openplan/src/lib/api/place-geographies.ts (PLACE_GEOID_PATTERNS); kinds this job adds to the shared list

journeyFields.refusal: used an AI feature; translation, AI moderation and AI synthesis are out of scope for this job

campaign.note: Counts come from the journey's moderation outcomes and published response. The review PDF must carry each count as the phrase below, found on its page with the shared matcher (scripts/lib/pdf-text-match.mjs). The workbook is read by cell: one Contributions row per comment with its status, one Staff responses row per response with its sources. The public response page is read by the journey at every width and mode.

crossWorkspace.note: The same rule as the first job (KI-2026-11-14-060). The staff campaign target needs its API read refused as a data check and its page checked as a page check.

participantChecks.note: Requests an anonymous participant sends with no session. campaign-read is GET /api/engagement/campaigns/<id>; campaign-items-read is GET /api/engagement/campaigns/<id>/items; review-pdf-download and review-xlsx-download are GET /api/engagement/campaigns/<id>/reports/<jobId>/download with format pdf or xlsx. public-portal-read is GET /api/engage/<shareToken>, which answers 200 and must carry none of the staff-only field names.
